entries.title: Job 13:1
segments: ¶"Behold, my eye has seen all [this], My ear has heard and understood it.

entries.title: Job 13:2
segments: What you know, I also know; I [am] not inferior to you.

entries.title: Job 13:3
segments: But I would speak to the Almighty, And I desire to reason with God.

entries.title: Job 13:4
segments: But you forgers of lies, You [are] all worthless physicians.

entries.title: Job 13:5
segments: Oh, that you would be silent, And it would be your wisdom!

entries.title: Job 13:6
segments: Now hear my reasoning, And heed the pleadings of my lips.

entries.title: Job 13:7
segments: Will you speak wickedly for God, And talk deceitfully for Him?

entries.title: Job 13:8
segments: Will you show partiality for Him? Will you contend for God?

entries.title: Job 13:9
segments: Will it be well when He searches you out? Or can you mock Him as one mocks a man?

entries.title: Job 13:10
segments: He will surely rebuke you If you secretly show partiality.

entries.title: Job 13:11
segments: Will not His excellence make you afraid, And the dread of Him fall upon you?

entries.title: Job 13:12
segments: Your platitudes [are] proverbs of ashes, Your defenses are defenses of clay.

entries.title: Job 13:13
segments: ¶"Hold your peace with me, and let me speak, Then let come on me what [may]!

entries.title: Job 13:14
segments: Why do I take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in my hands?

entries.title: Job 13:15
segments: Though He slay me, yet will I trust Him. Even so, I will defend my own ways before Him.

entries.title: Job 13:16
segments: He also [shall] be my salvation, For a hypocrite could not come before Him.

entries.title: Job 13:17
segments: Listen carefully to my speech, And to my declaration with your ears.

entries.title: Job 13:18
segments: See now, I have prepared [my] case, I know that I shall be vindicated.

entries.title: Job 13:19
segments: Who [is] he [who] will contend with me? If now I hold my tongue, I perish.

entries.title: Job 13:20
segments: "Only two [things] do not do to me, Then I will not hide myself from You:

entries.title: Job 13:21
segments: Withdraw Your hand far from me, And let not the dread of You make me afraid.

entries.title: Job 13:22
segments: Then call, and I will answer; Or let me speak, then You respond to me.

entries.title: Job 13:23
segments: ¶How many [are] my iniquities and sins? Make me know my transgression and my sin.

entries.title: Job 13:24
segments: Why do You hide Your face, And regard me as Your enemy?

entries.title: Job 13:25
segments: Will You frighten a leaf driven to and fro? And will You pursue dry stubble?

entries.title: Job 13:26
segments: For You write bitter things against me, And make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

entries.title: Job 13:27
segments: You put my feet in the stocks, And watch closely all my paths. You set a limit for the soles of my feet.

entries.title: Job 13:28
segments: "Man decays like a rotten thing, Like a garment that is moth-eaten.
